{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''individual''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspatial]] [[Physicist/Legends|physicist]] at some point between the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] around [[25,200 BBY]] and the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In a romantic&mdash;albeit somewhat inaccurate&mdash;way, they proclaimed the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellia]], and [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan]], as well as the location known as the [[Ginn Jump/Legends|Ginn Jump]], as the four "vertices" of a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that came to be known as the [[Tetrahedron]].<ref name="TEA" />
